bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the daemon to (e.g., `127.0.0.1` for local only, `0.0.0.0` for all interfaces).

rpc_bind_port.description: Port for the RPC server to listen on.

p2p_bind_port.description: Port for the P2P network to listen on.

p2p_bind_max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous incoming P2P connections.

rpc_enabled.description: Whether to enable the RPC server.

data_dir.description: Directory where blockchain data and wallet files are stored.

log_file.description: Path to write daemon logs (leave empty to disable file logging).

target_block_height.description: Block height at which to stop syncing (for testing/pruning). Use 0 for normal sync.

dns_seeding.description: Enable or disable DNS seeding to discover peers.

seed_nodes.description: Explicit list of seed nodes (peer addresses) to connect to.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections per IP address (0 = unlimited).

prune_blockchain.description: Enable blockchain pruning to reduce disk usage.

limited_rpc.description: Enable limited RPC mode (for public node deployments).

rpc_workers.description: Maximum number of threads handling RPC requests.

upnp.description: Enable automatic port forwarding via UPnP.

max_incoming_connections_per_block.description: Maximum incoming connections allowed during block sync (DoS mitigation).

blocks_dir.description: Alternative directory for blockchain block storage.

peer_id_file.description: Path to persist the node's peer identity file.

ipv6_enabled.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support (P2P and RPC).

block_threads.description: Number of threads for block verification (0 = auto, usually equal to CPU cores).

verify_threads.description: Number of threads for block verification during initial sync.

public_node.description: Mark this node as a public node (enables additional RPC methods).

rpc_methods.description: List of allowed RPC methods for CORS-enabled public nodes (empty = all).

items.description: Name of an RPC method, e.g., `get_info`, `get_blocks`.

rpc_cors_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS headers (only used if `rpc_methods` is set).

rpc_rate_limit.description: Maximum RPC requests per second per IP (0 = unlimited).

rpc_max_request_size.description: Maximum RPC request payload size in bytes (0 = default limit).

free_space_min.description: Minimum free disk space (in MB) required before the daemon refuses operations.

background_mining.description: Enable or disable background mining (only if CPU mining is compiled in).

mining_threads.description: Number of threads to use for background mining.

trusted_daemon_url.description: URL of a trusted daemon (e.g., for wallet proxy mode or remote node use).

daemon_url.description: URL of the daemon to connect to (for wallet proxy mode).

trusted_ca_file.description: Path to custom CA bundle for TLS verification (e.g., `/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt`).

rpc_enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for the RPC server.

rpc_tls_cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate file (required if TLS enabled).

rpc_tls_key_path.description: Path to TLS private key file (required if TLS enabled).

max_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent block downloads (sync tuning).

block_download_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) to buffer per block download (sync tuning).

prune_height.description: Height at which to start pruning (must be ≥ current blockchain height if pruning enabled).

keep_blocks.description: Retain block index for faster queries (increases disk usage).

no_time_check.description: Disable strict block time validation (useful for testing or VMs with unstable time).

no_strict_sort.description: Disable strict peer sorting during selection (useful for edge cases).

fast_sync.description: Enable fast sync via checkpointing to speed up initial sync.

out_peers.description: Maximum number of outbound (outgoing) peer connections.

in_peers.description: Maximum number of inbound (incoming) peer connections.

p2p_debug.description: Enable verbose P2P protocol logging (for debugging).

rpc_debug.description: Enable verbose RPC request/response logging (for debugging).

peer_db.description: Path to the peer database file (for P2P peer management).

state_file.description: Path to the state file (for resuming sync after restart).

trusted_key_file.description: Path to a file containing trusted public keys (e.g., for bootstrap validation).

bootstrap_file.description: Path to a file containing trusted bootstrap peer list.

trusted_daemon_pubkey.description: Public key of trusted daemon (hex-encoded) for secure remote node use.

pidfile.description: Path to write daemon PID file (used for service management).
